create.name: Austyn Wells
create.bio:
Austyn Wells is a spiritual medium and author who calls her work soul gardening. For more than twenty years she has given readings and mentored people through crossroads and bereavement, including the loss of animal companions, and she is a certified grief counsellor who also draws on shamanic practice, energy work and ceremony. She has presented at Omega Institute, at the Edgar Cayce centre in Virginia and at the Sun Valley Wellness Festival, and served for eight years on the board of the Afterlife Conference.

Her book Soul Conversations sets out how to develop intuition, open the heart and build a relationship with the divine, drawing on her own path as a medium; it won two COVR awards and a Nautilus gold medal. She also created two card decks, Divine Spark for developing mediums and Divine Insight for everyday intuition. In 2020 she led free nightly meditations for 170 nights, which grew into the DailyMeds library and her AWSM Family, an online membership with weekly group meditations, small-group readings and a private community. She still hosts a free Wednesday evening meditation on Zoom, offers private mediumship and soul-guidance sessions, runs online courses such as a thirty-day spiritual self-care journey, and leads small group retreats abroad.

books.title: Soul Conversations
books.author: Austyn Wells
books.description: Her guide, drawn from her own life as a medium, to developing intuition, opening the heart and building a living connection with the divine and with those who have died.

courses.title: AWSM Family Membership
courses.description: An online membership with tiered paths: access to her DailyMeds meditation library, live group meditations twice a week and a private community, with higher paths adding monthly small-group readings with Austyn.

courses.title: Spiritual Self-Care: A 30-Day Journey
courses.description: A self-paced thirty-day programme of short daily practices, meditations, journaling and time in nature to quiet the mind and listen inwardly, with lifetime access.

courses.title: DailyMeds Meditation Library
courses.description: A library of about 175 recorded sessions, each pairing a short teaching with a guided meditation, born from the nightly meditations she led in 2020.

courses.title: Sessions with Austyn
courses.description: Private online sessions including mediumship sittings, soul gardening sessions and soul search sessions, booked through her scheduling page.

free_resources.title: Free Wednesday Night Meditation
free_resources.description: A free weekly Zoom class on Wednesday evenings (Pacific time): she opens with a talk on a spiritual theme, then leads the group in meditation.

free_resources.title: Conscious Breath and Tree Meditation
free_resources.description: A 25-minute guided meditation on her YouTube channel using breath and the image of a tree.
